story.title: Former OpenAI Employee Allegedly Received Saudi Support in Device Planting Case
story.summary: Abdulrahman Alfozan, a former OpenAI employee, is accused of planting a device and allegedly received support from Saudi sources. U.S. prosecutors claim he was in frequent communication with an unnamed member of the Saudi Royal family and that a Saudi military member funded a one-way plane ticket for Alfozan's wife and son to return to Saudi Arabia.

timeline_highlights.title: Saudi Engineer Charged with Planting Listening Device at OpenAI Offices
timeline_highlights.summary: Abdulrahman Alfozan, a Saudi national and engineer at OpenAI, has been charged by the FBI for allegedly planting a hidden recording device in a conference room at the company's San Francisco office. The device, reportedly wrapped in toilet paper, was discovered inserted into a USB port on the back of a television. Alfozan had been employed at OpenAI since June 2025 before his arrest.

related_stories.title: Tragic Drownings Claim Lives of 12 Migrants Off Greek Islands
related_stories.summary: In two separate incidents off the Greek islands of Lesbos and Samos, 12 migrants, including an infant, have drowned. Authorities reported that another 22 individuals were rescued, and a search-and-rescue operation is currently ongoing.

related_stories.title: Houthi Missile Attack on Yemeni Training Camp Results in 53 Deaths
related_stories.summary: A missile attack by Houthi rebels on a Yemeni government security forces training camp in Shabwa province has resulted in at least 53 fatalities and over 200 injuries. This incident marks the largest single loss of life since the civil war reignited in September. The camp was reportedly being used for training new recruits when it was struck by multiple missiles.

related_stories.summary: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio is in Uzbekistan to enhance trade and diplomatic ties with Central Asia. During his visit to Samarkand, he discussed plans for new commercial agreements and cooperation on critical minerals, emphasizing the U.S. commitment to the region.

related_stories.title: Macron Condemns Violent Protests Across France
related_stories.summary: France's President Macron has condemned the violent protests that erupted across the country over the weekend. The unrest, characterized by looting and clashes, has raised concerns about his political authority and increased his isolation amid ongoing tensions.
